original_results.algorithm: Stream saved JSONL: product b + split test -> compare answers_by_depth[5] with gold per task; product c + question choice -> test uses saved selected/reverse_selected; wording_shift uses argmax(raw_scores) mapped through that row candidates, then compares with gold; split labels retained separately. No model execution.
